exposure: Surgical repair for tetralogy of Fallot and absent pulmonary valve syndrome
outcome: Surgical repair procedures (patch closure of ventricular septal defect, right ventricular outflow tract reconstruction, removal of bronchial obstruction by anterior translocation of pulmonary artery)
cohort: A 3-month-old girl weighing 3.6 kg, diagnosed with tetralogy of Fallot and absent pulmonary valve syndrome.
finding: The study describes the surgical technique used to repair tetralogy of Fallot and absent pulmonary valve syndrome in a 3-month-old patient.
